reason: The concession about something "intrinsically funny" yields to the dismissive verdict "little else to offer".
"Inept and ridiculous" sounds critical, but "hilariously" could describe either enjoyable comedy or laughable incompetence.
"Compelling anatomy of grief" praises the film's treatment despite its sorrowful subject.
"Facile technique" and "so little movie" dismiss the film as superficial.
"Riveting" praises the film, while "racial prejudice" describes its subject rather than the critic's verdict.
The clause after "but" criticizes the film because "its brains are in no particular place at all".
Making "the audience hostage to his swaggering affectation of seriousness" condemns the film's emotional manipulation.
"Routine, harmless diversion and little else" is dismissive faint praise.
Calling the film "as unseemly as its title suggests" expresses disapproval.
"Encourages rueful laughter" suggests successful humor, but "only an indian-american would recognize" could also criticize limited appeal.
"No heartstring untugged and no liberal cause unplundered" sarcastically criticizes emotional and political exploitation.
